content: Ewa'yoo (5000) numu tunakapunnedu ka Te Pabe'e Jesus-witu naka'oedyuku manepetuga. Ka Peter togesoo mu numu yadooewunu, mu numu nananesootuhidu Sadducee mee nananeadu-nagatu, mu Jew tukwutumadu-no oe petuhooga. Mu Sadducee ka gi numu namayoda-kwi tunaka'oedyukute. Umu ka Peter sutakute ka meeoo numu oo tunedyooe soo Te Pabe'e ka ya'ese namayoda. Mu Jew natukwutumawabe ka Peter noko John tukwutuma nobe-kwi wudumedow, ka mooasoo o togano-ga'a, nagutza saa'asoo ooka tu nehane-kwi.
Oogow mooo'a mu Jew tutunehanedu Jerusalem-wi'yoona tunehane.
Mu numu moohedu mee nanane'a Annas, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, ewow tu nananumu-no oe.

Mu tutunehanedu yise mu tukwutumadu meeoo netamma, “Ka Peter noko John ne kobenatoo bitooa,” mee'e. Ka mu nabi petuhoose, mu tutunehanedu mu mooe ohobu tubengakooha. “Haga pooha-ma mu ka gi nummedu mabesakupu? Haga ooka mu mabesaku tuungu?”
Soo Peter ka Te Naa Besow Pooha-toohakwi mu Jew tutunehanedu nanekwegea, “Ha'oo mu ka besa ne manakwe sapa mu gi besa mee netamma? ‘Haga pooha-ma mu ka nana besa mayugwe?’ mee umu.

Numme no'oko mu Jew numu noko mu tuukwekwu. Soo Te Pabe'e pooha besa oo mayugwe. Tooe mu ka Te Pabe'e batsa tuunguse sapa, soo Te Naa Pooha yise oo ya'e-kwikoo oo miyoda. Ookowsoo pooha-ma soo nana namagwetzoi.
Ka te mooa nayadooawabe tubo-kwa'nesoo manekena mee'e,

content.text: ‘Soo mumme nanesootuhi moohedu ka pumme tu tupe-makana wuni, soo Te Naa meeoo ka puma tu nobe-tookwuna netamma, “Mow soo tupe tubetsetu.” ’

content: Soo Te Pabe'e ookow tupe-kwa'ne'yoo.
Te Pabe'e Jesus suu'mu te magwetzoikwudu. Gadoo'oo haga oogow-kumisoo te magwetzoi-wa'ne'yoo.”

Mu tutunehanedu mu sopedakwatoo ka mu Peter noko John gi natunedyooepu yise mu tumadugu-kwitu sopedakwatoo ka Te Pabe'e Jesus-witu gi nasookwina mu waha. Mu Jew numu moohedu mu nesookwuga'e. Mu Jew tutunehanedu mu sopedakwatoo ka Te Pabe'e mu naka nagemo'o.
Soo nana namagwetzoipu ooka Peter noko John-kumabasoo wunu, gi hownnekoo umuoo yise ha'yoo mu netamma-wa'ne'yoo.
Mu tutunehanedu mu Peter noko John puuwanatoo tayahoo.

“Ha'oo sakwa tamme mu naana sootunaga?” mee yise unnemo'o. Yise meeoo, “No'yoona mu numu Jerusalem-witu mee unakwe, ‘Masoo nana Te Naa pooha-ma besa manepu-ga'yoo!’ Gi hownnekoo tamme oo nesootu'adyae-wa'ne'yoo.
Tamme sakwa mu naana neta, umu sakwa gi ka Te Pabe'e pooha-witu ka mu numu tuukwepana.”
Mu Peter noko John oetusoo bise yise meeoo mu netamma, “Gi mu numu tuukwepana ka Mu Pabe'e pooha-witu.”
Soo Peter yise meeoo mu tutunehanedu netamma, “Mu oo sopedakwatoo ka besa oo manepunnena, numme haa'a ka Te Naa nakabetseakwu pute mumme? Numme ka Te Naa nakabetseakwu gi mumme.
Numme gi hownnekoo ka mu numu ka Te Pabe'e-witu tuukwemakwu-wa'ne'yoo.”

Mu tutunehanedu tooe how tooe mu yugwekwu ka Te Pabe'e-witu gi mu wahamakwu. Umu yise mu sukwe tzama'wu ka gi hekwi sapa meeoo mu netammana. Mu tutunehanedu mu numu-ma sua'e ka Te Naa-matoo mu nanetzakwiya'e ka hemma manekwi.
Soo Te Naa magwetzoipu nana mooasoo watsu mano tomopu (40).
Mu Peter-no John yise pumme tu tzama'wuse, tu pupua'amu-matoosoo kodyuka. Mu Peter-no John yise mu tunehanedu unnena mu tuukwe'e.
Umu yise no'yoona oo nakase, nanesootuha'e, Te Naa-matoo mee unnemo'o, “Te Naa numu manumudoopu. U no'okosoo hemma madidu. U no'okosoo hemma ne nemadunagapunnedu.
U, Ne Naa, ume pooha ka o'nosoo ne nanumu David mee naneadu ka ume naka'oedyukudu tubo tuungupu u-kwitu.

content.text: ‘Mu wakwawa'a unu sutakugonnona ka Te Naa unu netumoo'oona oo-no nagoe sokwama pana gi how mane-wa'ne'yoo.
Ewa'yoo nanakumma'yoosoo numu moohedu nana-no tooe how tooe ka Te Pabe'e Jesus Te Naa tuutzeana mooe yugwekwu,’ mee'e

content: Meno'o tamme ekow poonne mesoo David yadooapu ka Herod-noko Pontius Pilate mu tukwutumadu-no mu te nanumu Jew-no tuwazoo apegea ka Te Pabe'e batsakwu mee unnena oosoo ume nakabetsea. U, Ne Naa, tunetutzeana, Te Pabe'e mee'e u.
Ume tunetammana yoo saa'a manedooa.
U, Ne Naa, oo sooma'yu mu tunehanedu naana ka Peter noko John manayahakwu mee. Gi mu tutunehanedu naana-ma ne suikwununumme u natuungu, no'oko numu u-witu numme mesoo tuukwedooa.
U pooha-gana mu numu numme tzapoonnekukwu. U, Ne Naa, mu tuoegoedu besa manekwuna, ne tzapoonekwuna u pooha-ga'yoo.”

Ka nanesootuhimakwuse soo mu nobe wudyutsungawunu. Oosoo Te Naa Besaa Pooha oo wudyutzengewunu. Oosoo Te Naa Besa Poohasoo umu wumana, umu gi sua'ena ka Te Naa unnena wahagonno. Umu yise ka Te Naa unnena mana kwaya'a-kwidooe wahammo'o.
O'no yise no'yoona mu tunaka'oedyukudu besa nana-matoo sokwama. No'okosoo hemma nanatummatza'e, gi hemma nananetumoo'e.
Mu tuukwewabe meeoo ka Te Pabe'e-witu waha, “Soo Te Pabe'e ka namayodase tusootabuese, yise ka Te Naa pooha mu numu tzapoonnekute.” Soo Te Naa ka mu tunaka'oedyukudu sootuhi.

No'okosoo hemma mu tunaka'oedyukudu hee-ga'yoo ka Te Pabe'e tubewabe noko nobe-ma mu tumukukwu ka oo mu soomanakwe. Mu Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe tumasumudoona mu numu yise gi hee-gakoo ka hemma mu sookwina oo-matoo mu hanekute.
Sumu'yoo nana Joseph mu Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe Barnabas
mee oo ne'a, puusoo tubewa-ga'yoo
ka tubewa-ma tumuse, no'oko pumme tu tumanagakuna ka Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe heme.

footnotes.text: Soo Barnabas, numu tunemabetsabekudu mee na'unnedu.
